violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)
violation_type.short_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation it was found that children under 18 months were being grouped with children up to 3 years old during the morning opening hours.

finding_variants.text: During the investigation it was found that children under 18 months were being grouped with children up to 3 years old during the morning opening hours.
A 15 month old infant was observed in the classroom with the oldest child being 32 months.    NOTE: Corrected when the 15 month old was taken to the infant classroom.
Observed caregiver supervising 16 children.  Youngest in the group was 11 months old and  oldest 4 years old. There was an 18 month  difference between the youngest to the oldest in  the group.
The age difference between the youngest and oldest kids was 30 months.
A 14 month old student was observed in a classroom with the oldest student being 5 years old.
There were 5 infants combined with older children. The youngest child was 3 months and the oldest was 10 yrs old. There was a 17 month infant in 18 month and up room.
